lead.title: Finland's Treat raises €3M pre-seed, led by byFounders and Illusian, for consultations where the doctor arrives already briefed by an AI intake tool
lead.deck: The Helsinki startup pairs adaptive symptom intake, which patients fill in in their own words, with a doctor-led consultation: the tool organises the context into a brief the physician reviews before the call, clinical decisions stay with the doctor, and identifiable data is kept away from public AI models. The round, led by byFounders and Illusian, the family office of Supercell founder Ilkka Paananen, funds an offering designed to complement the occupational healthcare employers already provide: an early signal of AI moving from the back office into the patient journey itself.

milestone.title: Unicancer switches on Harmonie, a data warehouse that for the first time links its large patient cohorts with the SNDS
milestone.summary: The federation of French cancer centres announced at the end of October that it had brought its CNIL-authorised health data warehouse Harmonie into service: it links the CANTO, ESME and ODH cohorts (nearly 200,000 patients treated in 80 facilities, up to 2,000 variables per patient) with France's national health data system (SNDS), with matching rates of 87% to 94%. It covers breast, lung and ovarian cancer first; colorectal, prostate and bladder cancer will follow in the second half of 2027.
milestone.why: Unicancer bills Harmonie as the first warehouse that lets its cohorts be cross-referenced with one another: a real-world data asset linked to the care pathway, valuable for effectiveness studies and market-access dossiers, and a playground for AI and RWE vendors able to operate within a regulated framework.

brefsEurope.title: FHF, Fehap and FHP call for a rethink of the "unworkable" timetable of Hospiconnect, France's hospital access-security programme
brefsEurope.summary: The three federations have asked Health Minister Stéphanie Rist to revise the June 2027 targets of the programme (Hop'EN 2 and Care strands), launched in January: 60% of facilities surveyed say they cannot meet the shared medical record (DMP) consultation targets, and the FHF proposes refocusing the milestone on achievable technical goals, citing immature solutions and insufficient funding.

brefsEurope.company: East Suffolk and North Essex NHS Foundation Trust
brefsEurope.title: ESNEFT adopts an "Epic-first" doctrine: any new digital solution must first show that Epic cannot meet the need
brefsEurope.summary: Its 2027-2030 strategy focuses on optimising its Epic EPR, including the Chart with Art ambient voice module, the Beans renal module and the MyChart patient app, before any third-party purchase or integration; targeted AI use cases range from decision support to imaging and digital pathology.

brefsEurope.title: DiggAi, Aindo and Transmural Platform among the 15 finalists of the MEDICA Start-up Competition, pitching on November 17 in Düsseldorf
brefsEurope.summary: DiggAi, founded by a physician and an engineer, sends practices pre-filled intake forms in 13 languages; Italy's Aindo generates synthetic health data for RWE and Belgium's Transmural Platform standardises the integration of remote-monitoring data into hospital EPRs. The final runs from 3pm to 5pm on the Main Stage, with €3,500 in prizes.

brefsEurope.title: Galeon, maker of an AI-built EPR deployed in 19 hospitals, gathers nine medical-AI case studies in Marseille
brefsEurope.summary: On November 18 at Hôpital Saint-Joseph, the France-hosted, HDS- and ISO 27001-certified vendor will feature among others Luxembourg's Hôpitaux Robert Schuman on HRS Sentinel, an AI deployed in emergency care, Atreon on remote monitoring in rheumatology, and France's Health Data Hub.

brefsEurope.title: At a Kaiko event, Insel Gruppe puts a number on clinical AI's bottleneck: over two years to get a single platform approved by the cantonal authority
brefsEurope.summary: At the Zurich AI Festival, the Bern hospital's CMIO argued for AI embedded in the EPR rather than one tool per use case; the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek and Kaiko presented a model that segments mesothelioma tumour volume on CT in one minute, where two experts agree in only 53% of cases.

brefsIntl.title: OpenAI launches computer-use agents that operate EHRs and payer portals, and opens 20+ health plugins in ChatGPT for Healthcare
brefsIntl.summary: Across 325 reviewed EHR inbox tasks, 99% of actions were rated clinically safe; CVS Health, Cigna, Abridge and Ambience are already deploying the agents. A direct threat to admin-automation startups lacking proprietary data or regulatory clearance.

brefsIntl.title: Apple opens Health AI Study, enrolling up to 200,000 Americans to test conversational AI on Apple Health data, with OpenEvidence
brefsIntl.summary: The iPhone app answers health questions using HealthKit data (heart rate, sleep, lab results) and measures trust, quality and comprehension of the answers; Apple says the data will not be used to train models.

brefsIntl.title: Heidi signs an MOU with Samsung Medical Center for a Korean version of its AI scribe, deployed on-premise
brefsIntl.summary: The scribe, which claims more than 3 million consultations a week across 190 countries, will be trialled as a proof of concept inside the hospital's infrastructure, linked to its EMR, with a Korean FHIR implementation guide among the deliverables.

word.full: Health Data Warehouse (French: entrepôt de données de santé)
word.definition: A database that gathers, cleans and makes searchable the data generated during care (patient records, coding, lab results, cohorts) so it can be reused for research and management, under authorisation and within a strict security framework.

parts.label: Connectors
parts.role: pull data from hospital software: EPR, administrative systems, PMSI coding, laboratory

parts.label: Standardisation layer
parts.role: harmonises and links sources, for example clinical cohorts with the SNDS

parts.label: Access framework
parts.role: CNIL authorisation, HDS-certified hosting and tools to inform patients and manage their objections

how.t: Connectors to clinical and business software feed the warehouse; Arkhn says its platform is usable within a few weeks of deployment in a university hospital.
Sources are linked together: at Unicancer, cohort matching to the SNDS reaches 87% to 94%, with up to 2,000 variables per patient.
Researchers run studies inside the secure environment after CNIL authorisation, while patients are informed and can object to the use of their data.

word.why: Health data warehouses turn care data into a research asset, and the French state keeps funding their networking: a DGRINES call for projects worth €2.325M for 2026 aims to expand or create networks of hospital warehouses. For investors, value lies with vendors that equip facilities (connectors, standardisation, study tools) and with those able to exploit the data for RWE and AI, with HDS and CNIL compliance as a barrier to entry.

startups.name: Arkhn
startups.use: Hospital-wide data and agentic AI platform claiming 19 university hospital partners including Hospices Civils de Lyon and CHU Toulouse, HDS- and ISO 27001-certified

startups.name: Codoc
startups.use: codoc Warehouse, a Research Hub to run studies and codoc Transparency to manage patient objections, used by Gustave Roussy, Hôpital Foch and CHU Caen among others

startups.name: Aindo
startups.use: Generates synthetic health data for RWE and external control arms without exposing identifiable patients; a 2026 MEDICA Start-up Competition finalist
